source_root_cause: pi_chudnovsky rejects i32::MIN via checked_neg; the legacy Machin fallback and infallible approximation graph then perform unchecked precision arithmetic, return zero, and store it as a finest-precision shared constant result. Ordinary queries reuse that invalid cache.

baseline_revisions.result: Probe failed to compile because Computable has inherent add/multiply methods, not Add/Mul operators. No numeric replay executed.
300 ordinary cases; 56 invalid numeric returns. Near-integer warm preparation used precision 0 although the operation needs -2; those four cases are not same-precision warm controls.

400 ordinary cases with control, cold, matching-precision warm, and finer warm preparations. All 52 invalid numeric returns are cold interrupted evaluations. All 400 ordinary retries pass independent exact rational bounds.

required_work: Make interrupted or invalid-precision scalar evaluation return a typed failure; never return a zero or partially accumulated integer as a completed numeric result.
Prevent any failed evaluation, including a failure whose external abort flag is later cleared, from entering approximation or fact caches.
Check precision planning arithmetic before allocation, shifting, series work, or child evaluation; preserve every successful numeric contract.

Thread honest scalar evaluation failure and explicit resource admission through predicate and curve operations. Existing root/promotion counters exclude scalar work and are not a whole-operation bound.
Retain the full original cases, all failed runs, independent-oracle receipts, and proportionate performance/allocation/size evidence before admitting production changes.
scope: Prerequisite for complete scalar/curve resource control, addressing P4/P6/P11/T3. No production fix is admitted and the broader property, target and future-work scope is unchanged.
